name: Jump squat
summary: Squat down and jump up, landing softly back into the squat.
setup: Face the phone, feet shoulder-width. Squat to about a quarter depth, jump as high as you can, and land quietly with the knees bending to absorb it.
brief: Stand with the feet shoulder-width. Squat to about a quarter depth, jump as high as you can, and land quietly with the knees bending to absorb it.
why: Facing the phone the knee angle dips before each jump, so reps are counted. Landing mechanics happen too fast to judge reliably.
regression: Small hops; squat with a heel raise.
contraindications: Knee or ankle injury; anyone told to avoid impact.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Landing with stiff legs
faults.tip: Bend the knees and hips on landing so it is quiet.

faults.label: Knees caving on landing
faults.tip: Land with the knees over the toes.

faults.label: Landing stiff and loud
faults.tip: Noise is force. Absorb the landing through the hips and knees.

faults.label: Knees caving on landing
faults.tip: The landing is where knees collapse inward. Stop the set when they do.

guide.surface: A floor with some give; not concrete.

points.t: Dip into a quarter squat before every jump.
Bend on the landing; track over the toes.
